## About Emma

Emma Rodriguez is CEO of RetailFlow, joining 5 years ago from Myer where she was Operations Director. The board brought her in specifically to modernize RetailFlow and drive digital transformation.

Emma is under pressure to deliver results on the transformation agenda while navigating the competing priorities of growth, profitability, and organizational readiness.

## Strategic Focus

- Digital transformation and AI adoption
- Competitive positioning against online retailers
- Board expectations and investor relations
- Balancing speed with bringing people along
